governed_construct: A module specifier string that imports an external dependency: the source string of an import declaration (including `import type`), an export-from declaration (`export ... from` / `export * from`), or a dynamic `import()` call, whose value is not a relative or absolute path (does not start with `./`, `../` or `/`). Relative/absolute local-file imports are not instances.
interpretation: The rule (Deno-style) forbids bare package specifiers for external dependencies: every external dependency must be written with an `npm:` or `jsr:` prefix. An instance is the module specifier of any import declaration, type-only import, re-export (`export ... from`), or dynamic `import()` that names an external package rather than a local file. It conforms if it starts with `npm:` or `jsr:`; a bare package name such as `zod`, `cors` or `@supabase/supabase-js` violates, whether imported for values or only for types, statically or dynamically. Local imports (`./`, `../`, `/`) are not instances, so a file importing only local modules is NOT_APPLICABLE. Mentions of bare imports inside comments or string literals are not imports and are ignored. Edge decisions not exercised by the fixtures: `node:` built-in specifiers and full URL specifiers (`https://...`) are not bare specifiers and are treated as not violating; `require()` calls, if present, would be treated like dynamic imports.
